MlxConcurrencyPrimitives.Orders: unordered monotonic acquire release acq_rel seq_cst

Builtin.name: @cmpxchgStrong
Builtin.shape: @cmpxchgStrong(T, pointer, expected, new, success, failure) -> (bool, T)
Builtin.result: whether it swapped, and the value seen (expected when it swapped)

Builtin.name: @cmpxchgWeak
Builtin.shape: @cmpxchgWeak(T, pointer, expected, new, success, failure) -> (bool, T)
Builtin.result: as @cmpxchgStrong; may fail spuriously, so callers loop

CallShapes.AtomicType: an integer of 1, 2, 4 or 8 bytes, bool, an enum, or a pointer; `pointer` points to a T
CallShapes.Names: orders and operations are written as bare names, not values: `seq_cst`, `add`
CallShapes.Operations: xchg add sub and nand or xor max min
CallShapes.OrderRules: a load does not release (not release, acq_rel); a store does not acquire (not acquire, acq_rel); @atomicRmw is at least monotonic; @fence is acquire, release, acq_rel or seq_cst; a compare-exchange's success order is at least monotonic and its failure order is neither release nor acq_rel and not stronger than the success order
CallShapes.Signedness: max and min, and the sign extension of narrow results, follow T

MlxConcurrencyPrimitives.Validation: Invalid order/operation combinations are compile errors where statically known.
MlxConcurrencyPrimitives.Volatile: Volatile controls observable memory access and is not inter-thread synchronization.
MlxConcurrencyPrimitives.DataRace: Non-atomic concurrent conflicting access with at least one write is undefined behavior.
